assertions.assertion: States deleting a space is a soft delete: pool data is blocked from reads and writes but retained
assertions.rationale: States delete is a soft delete: pool data blocked but retained.

assertions.assertion: Mentions ISpaceAdmin.UndeleteAsync restores the space and its matching rules
assertions.rationale: Says ISpaceAdmin.UndeleteAsync restores the space and its match rules.

assertions.assertion: Advises authorizing and auditing pool reassignment and deletion as security-boundary changes, reserved for deliberate procedures
assertions.rationale: Treats delete/undelete/pool reassignment as security-boundary changes with per-space authorization, auditing and trusted operators.
